purpose: Sanitized root control manifest. Revision 17 reconciles the Phase-1 CLEAN overlay to the actually enabled scheduler pool while preserving inactive workers' base/restoration metadata and all clean-boundary safeguards.

config_resolution.resolution_rule: After reading this root manifest, resolve only the config destination appropriate to the current bootstrap role. Clean exploration workers must read only their own role-local config path and must never read DOWNSTREAM_STATE.json, O_OPERATIONS.json, another role config, another receipt namespace, or the shared aggregate ledger. While phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.active=true, a listed CLEAN role MUST apply only its own sanitized overlay entry as the current additive assignment before its base role objective; the overlay may change source focus/method/expected output but never weakens the role-local safety, evidence, continuation, anti-stop, checkpoint/resume, retry/backoff, recovery or clean-boundary contract. Non-exploration managed roles resolve their exact role entry from DOWNSTREAM_STATE.json. O operations roles continue to resolve from O_OPERATIONS.json.

global_safe_policy.control_freshness: At run start obtain latest note main SHA using a SHA-only Git-ref lookup. Fetch this manifest plus the role's designated config at that exact SHA, then repeat the SHA-only lookup before the first substantive semantic read. If head or relevant revision changed, refetch and restart pre-semantic bootstrap. The first role-local/public-source semantic read freezes the tuple for the invocation; later control changes are deferred to the next invocation.
global_safe_policy.receipt_chronology: Durable receipts must use actual observed offset-aware timestamps. Terminal receipt timestamp must be >= invocation start. If exact chronology cannot be established, preserve raw observations and mark chronology_valid=false.
global_safe_policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Capability/schema/tool discovery is observation-only. Never mutate repository or external state merely to test connector capability. Managed roles may mutate only exact destinations explicitly authorized by their frozen role config for substantive role work, with required CAS/readback discipline.
global_safe_policy.recurring_scheduler_persistence: For repository-enabled recurring managed roles, one invocation ending, checkpointing, finding no new evidence, hitting a runtime boundary, or stopping semantic work on post-freeze head drift is never successful completion of the recurring objective. Physical scheduler state is controlled separately.

semantic_inputs_forbidden: other clean-worker state or role config
commit messages/diffs/file snippets or other semantic payload obtained only while resolving repository head SHA
clean_exploration_boundary.receipt_rule: write only immutable role-local receipts without reading shared or other-role observability content; each receipt must identify exactly one frozen semantic control/config tuple, include current Phase-1 assignment_task_id when overlay applies, and satisfy receipt chronology
clean_exploration_boundary.feedback_rule: own sanitized feedback is self-local process quality control only and cannot convey novelty, relevance, acceptance/rejection, ranking, preferred mechanisms, O knowledge, or other-worker information
clean_exploration_boundary.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology and minimum predecessor chain. Quarantine stale/cross-role observability content and do not use it semantically.
clean_exploration_boundary.scope_guard: never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope
clean_exploration_boundary.head_lookup_transport: For cleanliness/freshness checks use Git ref object lookup only; do not use semantic commit/search payloads merely to learn head SHA.
clean_exploration_boundary.connector_mutation_boundary: Connector discovery and capability probing must be read-only. Clean roles may write only their own role-local state/output and immutable own receipt namespace when substantive work requires it.

phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.sanitization: This overlay contains only generic process/mechanism objectives and no O state, O-derived priorities, downstream judgments or other-worker semantic information.
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.assignment_precedence: For listed roles, this sanitized assignment is the current substantive objective during Phase 1. Pre-existing substantive objective and exact continuation remain fallback/restoration metadata and must NOT resume merely because this assignment completes, blocks or looks low-value.
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.completion_reassignment: On completing or blocking an assignment, checkpoint it and continue with the next generic unresolved Phase-1 leaf or transversal candidate within the same role's allowed public-source/own-state domain. Do not restore base work until Phase 1 ends or optimizer control cannot safely continue.
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.base_contract_non_regression: All role-local CLEAN isolation, anti-stop, continuation, checkpoint/resume, recovery, retry/backoff, evidence/provenance, exact-scope and scheduler-persistence clauses remain mandatory.

neuroscience.objective: Audit public mechanisms for robust latest-state reconstruction under partial observation, stale caches, memory/state mismatch and bounded-context execution. Produce generic mechanism/failure evidence only; do not read or infer O/downstream/other-worker state.
neuroscience.method: existing-solution audit first; direct mechanism synthesis second; compare freshness proof, state versioning, checkpoint lineage, idempotent readback and uncertainty handling; public sources plus own prior clean state only
neuroscience.expected_output: role-local source-qualified checkpoint plus receipt separating observation, inference and unverified claims, with exact tested scope

self_improvement.objective: Audit generic optimizer policies for forecast/reforecast, transversal candidate generation, alternative-plan switching and crash-safe evaluation when progress overruns expectations.
self_improvement.method: compare direct-vs-decompose rules, expected-time/success estimates, switching thresholds, evidence preservation and no-regression restoration metadata
self_improvement.expected_output: role-local candidate control policies and measurable switching/forecast criteria

open_source.objective: Audit public repositories/frameworks for orchestration, CAS/idempotency, checkpointing, claims, exact readback and branch/PR preparation executable with ordinary Chat-mode repository/tool surfaces.
open_source.method: prefer official repositories/docs; verify concrete APIs/artifacts; distinguish Chat-capable direct operations from unavailable/background/primary-writer-only actions
open_source.expected_output: role-local implementation-pattern matrix with exact source/version and capability boundary

failure_evidence.objective: Find and classify generic failure evidence for stale-state reconstruction, duplicate effects, false completion, unsafe handoff, hidden background assumptions, conflicting claims and non-idempotent retry.
failure_evidence.method: negative-evidence-first search; preserve counterexample scope; map failure trigger -> detectable signal -> fail-closed response -> recovery evidence
failure_evidence.expected_output: role-local failure/counterexample matrix usable for Phase-1 acceptance testing without O-specific semantics

reasoning.objective: Develop a generic deterministic architecture for latest-state reconstruction, non-conflicting task selection, direct-solution-first reasoning, decomposition only when unresolved, durable continuation and precise exclusive-action handoff.
reasoning.method: direct solution first; audit existing approaches before decomposition; prove invariants and generate transversal alternatives when branch count exceeds forecast
reasoning.expected_output: role-local architecture and proof obligations for the generic Chat-parity root

evaluation.objective: Define measurable generic acceptance tests for freshness, useful-output rate, duplication, persistence, conflict avoidance, recovery, handoff precision and unsupported-completion rejection in recurring Chat-capable workers.
evaluation.method: precommit metrics and pass/fail criteria; distinguish coverage from success; include adversarial and missing-capability cases
evaluation.expected_output: role-local executable/inspectable evaluation matrix and stopping criterion independent of O semantics

multi_agent.objective: Audit generic multi-worker concurrency/claim/decomposition methods that avoid duplicate work and write conflicts without hidden background subagents.
multi_agent.method: public-source audit plus own state; compare claim granularity, reservation, stale-claim recovery, parent/child integration and sequential-vs-parallel switch rules
multi_agent.expected_output: role-local concurrency/claim protocol candidates and failure tests

scientist_agents.objective: Audit generic reproducible agent-lifecycle patterns for durable evidence, provenance, continuation, verification and handoff of only irreducible exclusive actions.
scientist_agents.method: separate research claim from executable artifact; require source-qualified evidence and reproducibility hooks; preserve abandoned-branch evidence
scientist_agents.expected_output: role-local lifecycle/handoff protocol evidence and reproducibility criteria

physical_pool_observation.rule: Physical scheduler state is observational. Inactive roles remain preserved in role-local base/restoration metadata and are not current Phase-1 assignments unless independently re-enabled by authorized platform control.

migration.reason: Revision 16 counted long_horizon as active, but current scheduler observation shows it physically inactive. Revision 17 removes only that inactive role from the current overlay while preserving its role-local base/continuation metadata; no scheduler or enabled_desired change is performed.
migration.rollback: Restore DESIRED_STATE blob e319840755761e8aaf5c979598dd15ad6aeb79e1 only if the revised overlay prevents an active CLEAN role from safely checkpointing, loses base/restoration metadata, or violates the clean-exploration boundary. Never use rollback to enable/disable a physical scheduler or to resume base work merely because a Phase-1 leaf completes.
